name: Talk over long distance
summary: Radios hide in plain sight: CB sets in semi trucks, marine VHF on boats at every marina, and walkie-talkies in sports and toy stores. The antenna matters more than the radio: get it high and in the clear and range can double or more. Vehicle radios run straight off 12V, so a car battery and a small solar panel keep a base station going.

parts.why: CB, marine VHF, walkie-talkies and ham sets
A good antenna up high beats more power
A mast to get the antenna high

tips: Agree channels and call times with other groups before you split up.
Rough ranges: walkie-talkies 1–3 km, CB 5–30 km, ham HF radio can reach other continents.
Listen more than you talk: transmitting drains batteries and gives away where you are.
Never transmit without an antenna connected. It can damage the radio.
